$comment: SWAP LAYER — where the application under test actually lives, so agents ground locators and
endpoints in real source instead of inferring them from a ticket.
Committed and shared. `localPaths` stays EMPTY here on purpose — absolute checkout paths are
per-machine and go in the gitignored repo-map.local.json, same key names.
Keyed by tracker team/project. One team often spans several repositories, which is why
`interviewWhenAmbiguous` exists: the key prefix stops carrying the answer, and guessing produces

sourceControl.providerNote: azure-devops | github | gitlab | bitbucket. READ-ONLY access, always.

<TRACKER_TEAM>.note: Set interviewWhenAmbiguous to false only when the key prefix genuinely identifies one repository.

_localPathsNote: Real absolute paths live in the gitignored repo-map.local.json under a `localPaths` key using these same repo names. This field intentionally stays empty so the file is safe to share.

pipelineHints.$comment: Used by phase 1 to find and watch the deploy for a branch. Read-only.

<APP_UI_REPO>.notes: Which pipeline builds and deploys this repo, and which stage is the deploy gate.
